name: text-blend-overlap
title: Blend Overlap
description: Các ký tự ba màu xen kẽ khép sát vào nhau và phóng nhẹ, chỗ chồng lên nhau hoà thành màu mới.

moworks.author: moworks

options.blend: screen on dark, multiply on light

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Chars coloured in a repeating 3-colour cycle (demo violet #7d64ff, cyan #22bdd6, yellow #f2c84b), mix-blend-mode screen on dark (multiply on light); letter-spacing 0 → −0.3 em (chars move toward the line centre) with scale 1 → 1.12 over 0.9 s power2.inOut so neighbours overlap into mixed colours; GSAP yoyo: hold 1.3 s, return 0.9 s. Demo: in 0.4–1.3 s, back 2.6–3.3 s; loop 3.6 s. Params: tracking: khép chữ (−0.3 em) · scale (1.12) · duration (0.9 s) · blend: screen / multiply · colors: ba màu.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ sát vào nhau, màu chồng hoà
